objective: Determine whether the catalogue carries a Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer variant with fastener type bolt and diameter 8 mm.

params.matched_candidate: lookup at most one row from product_variants (prefer the CATALOGUE_CANDIDATES fact rows) WHERE brand normalized = 'heco' AND model/series normalized matches 'heco 3dw-64b' / 'zinc plated' AND product_name normalized contains 'nut bolt and washer' AND fastener type 'bolt' AND diameter '8mm'; match case- and whitespace-insensitive; LIMIT 1

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: {yes_no}: Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer (fastener type bolt, 8 mm) — {product_sku}
